requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall read the IWDG_SR.WVU field and return 1U when set, else 0U.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_SR_OFFSET / 4U] bit 2 is set and function returns 1U, or when bit 2 is reset and function returns 0U.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall read the IWDG_SR.RVU field and return 1U when set, else 0U.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_SR_OFFSET / 4U] bit 1 is set and function returns 1U, or when bit 1 is reset and function returns 0U.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall read the IWDG_SR.PVU field and return 1U when set, else 0U.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_SR_OFFSET / 4U] bit 0 is set and function returns 1U, or when bit 0 is reset and function returns 0U.

requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register.
requirements.verification: target_robot_test passes when no IWDG register is written during initialization and before any call to an IWDG LL function.
